description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's fast food restaurant in Surrey's 96 Avenue corridor, offering burgers, breakfast, McCafé beverages, and a full takeout menu. The location includes a drive-through and is part of the Canadian McDonald's chain, which operates the MyMcDonald's Rewards app for order-ahead and loyalty points. Touring cyclists will find it a reliable all-hours food stop on a busy suburban arterial.
